text: Also landed branch (commit fa0ea56, “feat: binary output support”), prompted follow-article showcasing run_pipeline() piping binary image data (OpenSlide/libvips → ImageMagick) Conda environments — writing article surfaced stdout/stderr always decoded UTF-8 text, corrupting binary payloads captured via "|". New binary = FALSE argument run(), run_bin(), run_pipeline(). TRUE, stdout/stderr captured raw vectors instead decoded text. Since processx shares one encoding streams process, binary = TRUE makes streams raw, even one actually carries binary data — format()/print() (condathis_result/condathis_pipeline) parse_output() check .raw() streams independently rather assuming stdout can binary; parse_output() aborts class condathis_parse_output_binary_stream asked parse raw stream. Binary streams never live-echoed console. Threaded : native_cmd() already unused encoding parameter (docstring already said "binary" raw output) — run() → run_internal_native() now actually passes . run_bin() threads encoding processx::run() run_process_with_input() calls directly (doesn’t go native_cmd()). run_pipeline() applies every process’s encoding uniformly. New R/read_all_stream_binary.R (later renamed/expanded, see ) processx’s read_all_output()/read_all_error() accumulate chunks via paste0(result, self$read_output()) — encoding = "binary", read_output() returns raw vector, paste0() coerces raw per-byte hex-string characters ("68" "65" "6c") instead concatenating bytes. Confirmed empirically live processx::process. Fixed looping read_output_bytes()/ read_error_bytes() (return real raw bytes regardless process’s configured encoding) c()-concatenating instead. Two serious, pre-existing bugs found (binary — affect plain text mode , platform, whenever output large enough): Deadlock: run_process_with_input() (used run()/run_bin() stdin = "|") run_pipeline() called proc$wait() draining output. process’s combined stdout+stderr exceeds OS pipe buffer (64KB Linux, much smaller macOS/ Windows), child blocks write() whichever stream isn’t read yet, never exits, wait() never returns. Confirmed reproducing hang directly processx::process$new() (200KB stdout/stderr, correct shell redirection — earlier attempt flawed 1>&2 placement gave false “still hangs” result, re-verified corrected command concluding fix worked). Sequential draining (stdout fully, stderr) identical failure mode, just roles swapped — also reproduced confirmed hanging. Silent truncation: proc$write_input()’s underlying write single, non-blocking syscall can short-write returns undelivered leftover, R wrapper (write_input()) discards. run_process_with_input()/run_pipeline() called closed connection immediately — silently truncating input larger OS pipe buffer, error.
